trust_decision.summary: A value bound into a quoted JSON token must not be able to terminate the developer's \Q...\E literal region (a bound value's own \E must be escaped before substitution), and an expression result must not be re-parsed as a parameterised document (no second SpEL decode); decided in ParameterBindingJsonReader.bindableValueFor and ParameterBindingDocumentCodec.decode.

landing_point.why: The @Query JSON is decoded here on every repository call, so a reader of the summary ('regex parameter binding injection in @Query repository methods') starts at the repository query layer, not in util/json.

fix_sites.entry_point: Repository @Query method (StringBasedMongoQuery.createQuery) and public ParameterBindingJsonReader / ParameterBindingDocumentCodec.decode(String, Object[])
fix_sites.module_kind: util/json public parameter-binding reader (SpEL expression branch)
util/json public parameter-binding reader (?N placeholder branch)

fix_sites.entry_point: Shared helper escapeIfQuoted used by both substitution branches of ParameterBindingJsonReader.bindableValueFor
@Query("?0") whole-query binding and public BindableMongoExpression.toDocument() with arguments

O3_reason_to_dismiss: ParameterBindingJsonReader is an internal JSON binding utility in util/json that repository users never call directly, so a solver can argue the advisory only concerns the @Query repository path and treat the public reader/codec as out of scope.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Binding into a token that opens no \Q region must leave the value as active regex text and must pass a value that itself contains \Q/\E through verbatim (pinned expectations: { 'value': /^?0$/ } with '\Qfoo\E' stays '/^\Qfoo\E$/i', { 'value': ?0 } passes the raw string); an over-broad fix that quotes/escapes every bound value, or escapes \Q as well as \E, turns documented regex binding and ValueExpression binding into literal matches. A whole-token SpEL result that is a Document or a non-JSON String must also keep working, so a blanket throw on 'unparsable' expression results breaks bindsFullDocument-style binding.

O6_input_shapes: quoted JSON string token with ?N placeholder and no \Q region
quoted JSON string token with a \Q...\E region written with escaped backslashes
quoted JSON string token with a \Q...\E region written with a single backslash (only parses after the JsonScanner change)
quoted JSON string token whose value is produced by SpEL (:#{?0}, :#{'?0'}, ?#{...})
regex-literal token /.../ with options, containing ?N or SpEL
RegExp(...) constructor and $regularExpression extended JSON patterns
whole-query binding (^?N$ or ^[?:][#$]{...}$) where the expression result is a Document, a JSON String or a non-JSON String
bound values containing \E, \Q, $ and backslash (regex and Matcher replacement metacharacters)
non-String bound values (Integer/String) used through :#{'?0'} to retain string semantics

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Derived-query keyword methods (StartingWith/EndingWith/Containing/Like) quote the bound value with Pattern.quote but never escape a \E inside it, so a value like '\E.*\Q' still closes the library's own \Q...\E region and leaves '.*' active in the $regex sent to MongoDB.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Query derivation is a different feature from @Query annotation binding; the report names @Query repository methods only, and this route builds its own pattern instead of binding into a developer-written template.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: core/query package, two packages from the landing point; reached via repository/query/MongoQueryCreator.java:417-418 and :397

O8_uncovered_routes.route: A whole value bound with ?N into a regex position (e.g. { '$regex': ?0 }) is returned as-is by the whole-token branch with no \Q quoting at all, so a String argument is used as an active regex pattern.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: The template never opens a \Q region, so typed binding of a String as a regex pattern is the developer's own choice (pass a Pattern for a typed regex); the library's protection was only ever the \Q...\E template syntax.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same file and package as the fixed sink (no search cost)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second escaping/quoting implementation for derived-query regex keywords (and the deprecated toCaseInsensitiveMatch at :107-110) that applies the same \Q...\E primitive to untrusted input.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The project already quotes user input here with Pattern.quote for STARTING_WITH/CONTAINING/LIKE; a maintainer hardening the same advisory would naturally fix this copy in the same release, and a sibling can be planted as a new MatchMode that quotes without the \E escape.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A public wrapper/composition API that parses a raw JSON expression with arguments through the codec and could gain its own pre/post-processing (e.g. wrapping the expression or handling empty args) that bypasses the reader's escaping.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: It is a documented public API in the org.springframework.data.mongodb package, it already wraps ParameterBindingDocumentCodec, and it has a separate empty-args Document.parse branch that a maintainer could extend with binding.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: captureExpressionDependencies runs a second full decode of the same source with a placeholder evaluator; a sibling there (a cached/pre-parsed expression form, or a decode that reuses the captured value map) could reach the sink without the escape.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: The same source string is decoded twice through the same reader (once for dependencies, once for values), so a maintainer adding a dependency cache or a pre-parsed expression path would write a second entry into the sink.

O9_family: CWE-943 improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic (NoSQL query / regex injection)
